## 更新内容 / Changes

- 复制已有 Codex 实例时，可以按实际工作目录勾选要迁移的对话，也可全选或清空。主进程会重新验证目录选择，并在独立快照中同步过滤对话文件、SQLite 索引和项目会话状态；未知数据库关系或跨目录同 ID 冲突会拒绝发布副本。
- 会话详情默认显示最近 10 条可读记录，按时间顺序呈现；可连续查看更早或更新的记录，搜索从最近的匹配记录开始。
- 存储清单增加会话废纸篓备份及已识别暂存区盘点。清单只读；恢复状态不明的备份与暂存项显示警告，不提供直接删除。

- Copying an existing Codex instance now lets you select conversations by their actual working directories, with select-all and clear controls. The main process revalidates the choices and filters transcript files, SQLite indexes and project session state together in an independent snapshot. Unknown database relations or same-ID files that span different directories fail closed before the copy is published.
- Session details open on the latest 10 readable records in chronological order, with adjacent older and newer windows. Search opens on the latest matching records.
- Storage inventory now includes session-trash backups and recognized staging directories. The inventory is read-only; backups with unknown recovery state and staging entries show warnings and cannot be deleted directly there.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 支持范围 / Supported scope

本版本的按文件夹复制能力针对 Codex 会话目录与其已知 SQLite 索引结构；未知数据库关联结构和无法归属到单一工作目录的冲突版本会安全拒绝。Claude Desktop / CLI 的历史浏览能力不意味着支持跨客户端复制。详情中的“10 条记录”按客户端保存的可读事件 / 消息计数；Codex 工具调用可能分别计为多条。

Folder-scoped copying in this release applies to Codex session directories and recognized SQLite index schemas. Unknown database relations and conflicting file versions that cannot be assigned to one working directory fail closed. Claude Desktop / CLI transcript browsing does not imply cross-client conversation copying. The viewer's “10 records” counts readable client transcript events / messages; Codex tool calls can count as separate records.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本同时修正了 Claude 会话窗口导航烟测，使发布验证与最近 10 条记录界面一致。发布流程完成后由对应 tag 的 GitHub Actions 记录本版本源码与 macOS arm64 安装包构建，并上传 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The GitHub Actions run for this exact tag will record source verification and the macOS arm64 installer build, and upload `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
